headline: Operating Leverage Plays Out; Area Conversion Lifts Margins

highlights: Key Points  Indiqube’s reported revenue from operations came to Rs4,719mn (+34.8% YoY/+11.6% QoQ), 3.7% ahead of our estimate.
Adj EBITDA (our normalised, pre Ind AS 116 metric) of Rs1,024mn (+63% YoY and +37% QoQ) was a ~26% beat with Adj EBITDA margin at 21% (up 375bps YoY and 400bps QoQ).

Reported Ind-AS loss narrowed to just -Rs59mn vs - Rs299mn YoY — the smallest quarterly loss yet, nearing Ind-AS breakeven.  Operating leverage kicks in: The margin beat reflects operating leverage finally kicking in, with revenue growth (+11.6% QoQ) significantly outpacing cash lease payments (+4% QoQ).

VAS margins stepped up from ~15% to ~20% with the management indicating an 18–20% sustainable range.  Growth visibility strong, but H2 loaded: AUM reached 10.86msf across 138 centres/17 cities, of which 2.67msf is signed future supply and total unmonetised headroom is ~3.81msf (~85k seats, incl. 1.14msf of vacant operational space).
valuation: Client retention remained ~90%, with blended renewal escalations of ~5%.  We maintain BUY and roll forward our valuation to 10x Sep-28E EV/Adj EBITDA with revised TP of Rs270 (from Rs235 earlier).
Solar remains the key investment priority, with ~30MW operational, another ~30MW planned and ~Rs1,000mn annual capex targeting a ~3- year payback.
EBITDA by ~11% and ~8% on the margin step up, and roll our valuation forward to 10x Sep'28E EV/Adj.
